mapper.update: UPDATE volunteer_availability SET available_date = #{availableDate}, start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, available_date, start_time, end_time, status FROM volunteer_availability WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE volunteer_availability SET is_deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, available_date, start_time, end_time, status FROM volunteer_availability WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY available_date ASC, start_time ASC
